_comment: The cfn-guard suppressions the maintainers approved one resource at a time (#761): template, logical id, resource type, the registry rules suppressed on it, and the reason recorded beside each.

The one list. test/ash-guard-suppressions.test.ts and deploy/tests/cfn-lint-guard.py both read it and each fails on any suppression in templates/ that is not here, on an entry here that no template carries, and on a reason that differs from the one here.
A new suppression needs the same review the originals got: add it here in the same change that adds the suppressGuardRule call in lib/.

reasons.LAMBDA_INSIDE_VPC: Custom-resource responder: one codebuild:StartBuild call, no inbound path, no data.
Custom-resource responder: one codebuild:StartBuild call, no inbound path, no data.
Opt-in: set VpcId and VpcSubnetIds to confine egress to a 443-only SG and your NACLs. Empty (default) leaves egress open.

reasons.S3_BUCKET_SSL_REQUESTS_ONLY: enforceSSL already denies s3:* when aws:SecureTransport is false on this bucket and its objects (cdk-nag S10 checks it). The rule matches only a literal Principal "*", Resource "*" statement, which CDK does not emit.
